g.text: Intervals = staff-position steps, not semitones. Alternating first pitches on staff line / space.
No application changes. Wide ranges intentionally extend outside the four-line staff; no ledger lines.
1× = one SVG unit per CSS px at intrinsic width. Reduced = 0.55×. Zooming changes both.
Green = nominal pitch / first-note lyric axis. Color contours = interaction only; no colored ink at rest.
Reference: Greciliae 6.1.0 actual outlines; nominal-cell baseline +6; no font dependency.
